method: Built from pristine origin/main bc9a56a6 (git archive of HEAD, not the worktree's uncommitted debug edits) via rojo build examples/showcase.project.json. Studio playtest (Play, single client). Device simulator stopped with StudioDeviceSimulatorService:StopSimulationAsync() (it had been on: Xbox One 1920x1080, Fit to Window), so the viewport follows the Studio window; window resized via System Events on the Studio pid until workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize read exactly WxH. Demo selected with workspace.FacetShowcaseAPI.showNext until current==mounted==id (ok=true), then 2.0 s settle. Image = macOS screencapture -o -l <CGWindowID> of the Studio window only (so overlapping windows are excluded), cropped at the viewport origin (3,179) found with a full-screen red IgnoreGuiInset ScreenGui marker (marker removed before capture). Display 1x, scale 1.0 (crop px == viewport px).
note: default theme, default demo state (first tab), showcase chrome panel closed
